name: Universal Tests Are Complement Closed
statement: The complement in the fixed cube of a universal substitution test is universal, with the source's empty/full constant convention.
proof: The control transformation $(u,v)\mapsto(1-v,1-u)$ is a cube automorphism sending $H_T$ to $H_{T^{\mathrm c}}$. Maximum-generatedness and hence the three-section criterion are invariant under this transformation.
